question: Does being approved for the disability tax credit automatically make me eligible for the Canada Disability Benefit?
generated_answer: No. You must apply for the Canada Disability Benefit separately. You can apply for the Canada Disability Benefit after you receive your notice of determination from the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) that you are approved for the disability tax credit. You can also apply for the Canada Disability Benefit if you have been approved for the disability tax credit in the past. You do not need to reapply for the disability tax credit. You can apply for the Canada Disability Benefit online through My Account or by mail. You will need to provide proof of your disability and your income. You can also apply for the Canada Disability Benefit through a representative, such as a family member or a friend. If you are approved for the Canada Disability Benefit, you will receive a monthly payment. The amount of the payment will depend on your income and your family situation. You can also receive a one-time payment if you are approved for the Canada Disability Benefit. The one-time payment is equal to 12 times the monthly payment. You can use the Canada Disability Benefit to help pay for expenses related to your disability, such as medical expenses, transportation, and home modifications. You can also use the Canada Disability Benefit to help pay for other expenses, such as rent, groceries, and utilities.
